Red Lettuce

Updated 2026-08-08

The cheapest video-confirmed seed in the current build: 48C, Spring, 3 days, single harvest. Sell price per head is still unobserved.

Seed source & price

  • Red Lettuce Seed is sold in the Leafy Market "Seed & Fertilizer" tab at 48C (Basic quality). Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
  • The historical Alpha record listed Red Lettuce Seeds at 18C — superseded by the current-build 48C observation; kept as a lead only. Historical Farmer's Land — community-maintained player wiki page (Alpha build)

Growth & harvest

  • Season: Spring · Growth time: 3 days · Multi-harvest: none (one harvest per planting). Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)

Sell price (player) vs retail

  • Player sell price per head: unknown. Crop income settles as one combined Farming total in the daily settlement, so per-crop sell prices cannot be read off the settlement screen and none is published here. Unknown Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
  • Theoretical framework only (not an observed outcome): profit per occupied day = (sell price − 48C) ÷ 3 once a sell price is captured. Single-source Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
fruit

Strawberry

Updated 2026-08-08

The first video-confirmed regrow crop: 144C seed, Spring, 7 days to first harvest, then fruit every 3 days. Berry sell price is unobserved — the 18C-per-harvest figure is a cost-allocation model, not revenue.

Seed source & price

  • Strawberry Seed is sold in the Leafy Market "Seed & Fertilizer" tab at 144C (Basic quality); the purchase dialog separately confirmed 10 seeds = 1,440C. Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
  • The historical Alpha record listed Strawberry Seeds at 38C — superseded by the current-build 144C observation; kept as a lead only. Historical Farmer's Land — community-maintained player wiki page (Alpha build)

Growth & regrow

  • Season: Spring · Growth time: 7 days · Multi-harvest: every 3 days (regrows after the first harvest). Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
  • The historical Alpha record claimed daily fruiting after maturity with 10-20 berries per plot and a 20C sale value — Alpha data, not confirmed in the current build. Historical Farmer's Land — community-maintained player wiki page (Alpha build)

Sell price (player) vs retail

  • Player sell price per berry: unknown — never observed on screen, and the daily settlement does not break crop income down per crop. Unknown Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
  • Theoretical model (our derivation, not an observed outcome): seed-cost allocation ≈ 18C per harvest, assuming eight harvests in a full 30-day Spring (day 7, then days 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25, 28) with no missed regrowth, no season-boundary loss and no plant death. Profit/day = (sell price × yield − allocated seed cost) ÷ 3 — open until a sell price is captured. Single-source Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)

Fertilizer

Updated 2026-08-08

Officially flagged as miscalculating in the current build — the official advice is to avoid investing until it is fixed.

Shop price

  • Fertilizer retails at 288C (Rare quality) in the Leafy Market "Seed & Fertilizer" tab. Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)

Effect & the calculation bug

  • Official warning: fertilizer "is not currently calculating correctly", it is being looked into, and players should avoid investing in fertilizer until it is adjusted. Official Steam thread "Furtilizer not worth it" (Seansniper27; Jennoula, official)
  • One player's test matches the warning: roughly 8,000C of Legendary fertilizer (covering 8 of 24 plots) added about 79C of sales on a salad harvest. Single-source Steam thread "Furtilizer not worth it" (Seansniper27; Jennoula, official)
  • A second player reported selling 20 onions with 20 OGM and 40 onions with 40 OGM for the same 21,000C — consistent with the official bug warning, single report. Single-source Steam thread "OGM" (gamingmarcel20; Jennoula, official)

Hay

Updated 2026-08-08

Not a planted crop — wild grass produces it, and it doubles as chicken feed (see the animal database).

How to get hay

  • Wild grass produces hay regardless of its growth stage. Official · pre-EA documented The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! (official Steam announcement)
  • Players report getting hay by chopping bushes or looting crates and barrels on NPC farms. Single-source Steam thread "where can i find hay" (Tila)
  • Hay is the chicken feed — chickens pick grains out of hay/straw piles. Feeding details live in the animal database. Official Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read)

Derived analysis (our theoretical model, not an observed outcome): using only the video-observed seed cost and timing, the theoretical seed-cost allocation for Strawberry is 18C per harvest — assuming eight harvests during a full 30-day Spring (first harvest on day 7, then regrowth on days 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25, 28) with no missed regrowth cycles, no season-boundary loss and no plant death. This is not an observed outcome. The sell price per berry was not observed, so profit per day stays open: profit/day = (sell price × yield − allocated seed cost) ÷ 3 once a sale value is captured. For Red Lettuce the framework is (sell price − 48C) ÷ 3 per occupied day, sell price also unobserved. Enter your own observed sale price in the profit calculator.

How crop selling works

  • Harvested crops are sold through the CashIn Export Storage Chest by the Cargo/helipad area on the ranch. Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
  • Depositing pays nothing immediately — the income lands as one combined Farming total in that day's settlement, so per-crop sell prices cannot be read off the settlement screen and none are published here yet. Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)

Crop growingConfirmedPlayers can grow crops as part of the core ranch loop.Record the full plant-to-harvest interaction.
Seasons and daily cycleConfirmedThe world changes through seasons and a daily cycle.Check whether season limits vary by crop.

Auction marketConfirmedOfficial Steam material describes an auction market.Check fees, listing rules, and player access.
Missed harvestConfirmedFruit and vegetables are not destroyed if harvesting is delayed.Check whether quality or regrowth timing changes.
Plant death and seed lossConfirmedOfficial notes say seeds disappear when the plant dies.Record every condition that can kill a plant.
Recurring cropsConfirmedThe plantation system includes a simplified regrow flow.Measure first growth and later harvest intervals separately.
Luck and fruit countConfirmedFruit-count probability is influenced by player luck.Use repeated harvests; one yield is not a stable average.
Bulk buying and sellingConfirmedOfficial notes say all shops support bulk buying, and items can be sold in bulk to shop managers.Confirm per-shop limits and whether bulk affects price.
Plantation auto-harvestPending observationThe developer listed auto-harvesting as a post-demo priority.Do not assume it is available until a current build confirms it.

Seed cost and sell pricePending observationNo complete official price list was found.Capture buy and sell screens on the same game version.
Growth time, yield, and regrowthPending observationNo complete official timing table was found.Measure from planting day to harvest and count yield.
Core formula: crop profit per plot per day = (sale revenue − seed cost − repeat input costs) ÷ occupied days. Keep quality bonuses, processing, and market fees separate so the comparison remains reproducible. Enter observed values in the profit calculator.

How to build a trustworthy crop row

Record the game version, season, seed source, seed cost, planting day, harvest day, yield per plot, sale destination, sale price, and any quality or processing modifier. Use a control plot without bonuses, measure occupied days (not only the printed growth time), separate sale channels, and repeat the test at least once. The full verification workflow is on the methodology page.

Questions still open in the current build

  • Which crops are available in the initial Early Access build?
  • Which crops are season-limited, regrow after harvest, or work in greenhouses?
  • Do sprinklers require utilities, and what area does each model cover?
  • Do local markets, daily orders, and the auction use the same base value?
  • Which costs are per harvest, per planting, or one-time infrastructure?
